status: frozen before random-hyperplane scores, and before all SFace extraction/metrics
motivation: The predefined ITQ study did not improve closed-set rank1. Test whether more independent angular measurements reduce quantization error, while the cheaper transition may compensate for longer codes.
method: Public Gaussian random-hyperplane signs; established angular LSH, not a new hashing algorithm
frontends: SFace128 subsequent independent frontend on frozen images
projection_generation: For each input dimension and seed, generate standard_normal((2048,input_dimension)).T with NumPy default_rng, save the matrix, and use column prefixes. No seed/width chosen by observed test scores.
center_variants: subtract training-only mean from normalized embedding
training_rows: Same untouched565 identities in extended rows4992:, only used to estimate the centering mean
controls: original coordinate signs at the native dimension
training-centered coordinate signs at the native dimension
normalization_and_ties: Normalize source embedding or enrollment mean before the optional centering; sign>=0 is1; same deterministic gallery tie rule
evaluation: All predefined variants, both seeds, all20 frozen image assignments, all6 gallery sizes, calibration-only empirical/conservative thresholds, paired identity uncertainty, split0 index/capacity/fallback measurements
interpretation: FaceNet results are iterative development, not blinded confirmation. SFace outcomes were not observed when this protocol was fixed. Different frontends are not independent identity samples, and cross-dataset identity overlap has not been audited.
cost_rule: Longer codes increase storage and MPC work. Report actual measured costs before a quality/cost claim; current512-bit timings cannot be relabeled as1024/2048-bit timings.
selection_policy: Keep all widths/seeds/center variants. Report variability across seeds; freeze any selected method before subsequent secure-system confirmation. Do not treat a favorable seed as the method result.
